changes: Implemented Lattice Review Reflection Loop as host-neutral lifecycle evidence: added review loop record types and JSONL storage, five review_loop CLI commands, REVIEW gate blocking for open loops, resolved-close freshness/evidence invariants, status/session projections, process-fact registry coverage, and focused smoke tests.
usage: In REVIEW, run review_loop_start to open a loop, review_loop_iteration_add to record reflection/evaluation/decision, review_loop_status to inspect active/latest state, and review_loop_close --status=resolved|blocked|escalated to close recording-only loop state. Use review_loop_policy_show to inspect the conservative policy.
expectedOutcome: User expects Lattice to track bounded reflection loops during REVIEW without becoming an autopilot: open loops block REVIEW to TEST, resolved closes require fresh evidence, and no command executes rollback, host handoff, DONE, merge, or authority receipt changes.
actualTranscript: Observed: npm run build passed; npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke reported 37 passed and 0 failed; node bin/koala.js validate --story=B-7a34 passed npm test and verification intent coverage 15/15; three reviewer lanes and two Claude CLI plus Codex CLI host audits returned PASS after fixing Codex-reported correctness issues.
outcomeDiff: No expected-vs-actual product gap remains. One process-fact script still reports pre-existing autopilot/release drift, but review_loop contract entries themselves pass and are recorded as unrelated residual risk.
limitations: Process fact contract still has unrelated pre-existing autopilot_* and release_approve_push drift; review_loop-specific contract checks are registered and show no failure entries.
pitfalls: Use local worktree wrapper node bin/koala.js for gates; global lattice can point at another worktree and misreport Codex adapter material hash. Resolved close must include evidence refs and current materialHash.
